entry.title: Follow a small discovery outside
entry.summary: Pause for the moving leaves, a cloud, or an insect at work. A walk can make room for what your child notices.
entry.cue: They may stop, point, listen, or return to a tiny detail.
detail: Davies invites noticing colors, wind, droplets on leaves, and the sounds and smells outdoors. There can also be a quiet moment of looking together.

When you have time, follow your child’s pace. A discovery need not become a lesson: you can wonder together or find a name later. The book includes nearby parks and other places beyond home for families without outdoor space.
